{{Quote|Has fruitcake ever truly been anything other than decorative?|Decorative Fruitcake description|<ref name="SWG:TCOA">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>}}
'''Decorative Fruitcake''' was a type of decorative [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] investigated a case of missing [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] candy for the [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Saun Dann]]. Dann rewarded the spacer with a choice between the Decorative [[Fruit/Legends|Fruitcake]] and [[Decorative Varactyl Egg Nog]].
